As Enlink Midstream (ENLC) Market Value Declined, Tortoise Capital Advisors Lifted by $7.44 Million Its Stake; Intersect Capital Increased Position in Apple (AAPL)
May 26, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Tortoise Capital Advisors Llc increased its stake in Enlink Midstream Llc (ENLC) by 11.71% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Tortoise Capital Advisors Llc bought 437,613 shares as the company’s stock declined 17.15% with the market. The hedge fund held 4.17M shares of the public utilities company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $73.47M, up from 3.74M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Tortoise Capital Advisors Llc who had been investing in Enlink Midstream Llc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.95 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.91% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $16.3. About 166,896 shares traded. EnLink Midstream, LLC (NYSE:ENLC) has declined 21.83% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 33.38% the S&P500.
Intersect Capital Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 7.27% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Intersect Capital Llc bought 2,867 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 42,319 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $7.16 million, up from 39,452 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Intersect Capital Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Tortoise Capital Advisors Llc, which manages about $15.07B and $15.25 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Halliburton Company (NYSE:HAL) by 40,510 shares to 54,263 shares, valued at $2.65M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Phillips 66 (NYSE:PSX) by 5,262 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 10,953 shares, and cut its stake in Westlake Chemical Partners Lp (NYSE:WLKP).
